table_description: This silver-layer table stores cleansed and standardized core metadata for registered clinical trials sourced from public registries. It serves as an analytics-ready foundation for monitoring clinical study progress, operational milestones, and trial portfolio distribution.

columns.name: nct_id
columns.description: The unique ClinicalTrials.gov identifier assigned to the clinical study registry record.

columns.name: title
columns.description: The official or brief human-readable title describing the clinical trial protocol and therapeutic objective.

columns.name: overall_status
columns.description: The current operational recruitment and execution status of the clinical trial across all participating study sites.

columns.name: phase
columns.description: The regulatory clinical trial development stage indicating the investigational maturity and testing scope of the intervention.

columns.name: lead_sponsor
columns.description: The primary organization, institution, or pharmaceutical entity overseeing study initiation, protocol compliance, and operational governance.

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: The calendar date when participant enrollment formally begins or the first clinical procedure is performed.

table_description: This cleansed silver-layer table maps clinical study records to the specific medical conditions, diseases, or health indications investigated in each trial. It standardizes condition entities to facilitate downstream clinical cohort discovery, disease burden analysis, and cross-study comparisons.

columns.name: nct_id
columns.description: The unique National Clinical Trial registry identifier assigned by ClinicalTrials.gov to globally reference and track each registered study.

columns.name: condition_name
columns.description: The reported name of the disease, disorder, syndrome, or health indication targeted by the clinical trial protocol.
